name: SystemEarth
desc: AI and satellite intelligence to automate trade and sustainability compliance for global exporters. Compliance documents, sustainability data, and trade certifications flow through their platform. Macro tailwind is exceptional: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), deforestation regulations, and mandatory ESG reporting creating compliance infrastructure demand globally.
trigger: EU CBAM enforcement milestones (live 2026). First enterprise contract wins outside Singapore. Founder background confirmation — need domain expertise in trade compliance or sustainability regulation.

name: Fineksi
desc: Document automation for credit analysis in Indonesian banking and lending. Credit documents flowing through their automation layer. Indonesia has 270M people and a massive underserved credit market. Banks still process credit applications largely manually.
trigger: Confirmed bank integrations and ARR figures. Clarity on whether they're automation tooling (replaceable) or embedded infrastructure (sticky). Founder profile assessment.

name: BorderDollar
desc: Cross-border SME invoice financing platform. Sits inside the invoice payment cycle between exporters/importers and their cash flow gap, using unpaid invoices as collateral. $500B+ trade finance gap in Asia (ADB data). ASEAN cross-border trade growing fast.
trigger: Confirm paying SME customers beyond pilot stage. Founder background verification — not publicly available. Capital-intensive model needs confirmation of funding source for loan book (own capital vs third-party investors).

name: Integuide
desc: Industrial AI knowledge capture — body-cam recordings of senior technicians converted into searchable AI knowledge bases for junior field staff. Sits in the information flow between human expertise and operational execution. Heavy industry (mining, utilities, manufacturing) institutional memory problem is large and genuine. Founders: Hunter Jay (built Ripe Robotics) + Slava Chalnev (AI safety researcher).
trigger: Paying enterprise customers in mining or utilities — that's the willingness-to-pay validation. Hardware-adjacent (body cams) is a mild concern but product is software-first.

name: FlowGo
desc: AI accounting automation that runs inside WhatsApp, Telegram, and email. Deploys specialised AI agents for AP automation, sales order processing, collections, and reconciliation — connecting existing chat channels to accounting software (AutoCount, SQL Account, QuickBooks, SAP) without replacing them. Founders managed $15B+ in transaction volume and scaled workflows for 50,000+ SMEs.
trigger: Paying customers confirmed with MRR visibility. Accounting software integrations deepen to the point where migration means rebuilding the entire AP workflow — that's when it becomes a sticky information flow play rather than just workflow tooling. Watch for: Series A signal or strategic investor in AU/SEA fintech.

name: iBnkVault
desc: Cross-border payments platform for e-commerce merchants using stablecoin rails to settle in real-time, reducing cross-border fees from 3–5% to near-zero. Founders: Yi Zhang (blockchain infrastructure background) and Ivy Fan (managed millions in cross-border capital flows). Based Melbourne + Wyoming. Addresses a real problem but operates in an increasingly crowded stablecoin payments space.
trigger: Differentiated moat beyond stablecoin routing — what makes iBnkVault sticky once the e-commerce merchant is onboarded? Watch for: anchor merchant partnerships or a unique corridor that large players aren't serving well.

name: Orivfy
desc: AI authenticity and content verification platform. Detects and explains whether text, images, audio, or video are AI-generated. Provides transparent reasoning, confidence scores, and identifies the likely AI source model. B2B trust infrastructure play — sits between content platforms/enterprises and synthetic media verification. Regulatory tailwind: EU AI Act, platform liability frameworks tightening globally.
trigger: Paying enterprise customers and use case clarity (compliance, media, legal). Founder background and prior domain experience. Moat check: detection accuracy hold as generative models improve? Funding round announced.

name: Specific AI
desc: Deterministic, auditable AI workflow automation for regulated enterprise industries. Positions as zero-hallucination architecture — non-transformer approach targeting sectors (finance, legal, compliance) where LLM unpredictability is a liability. Estonia HQ — strong engineering pedigree. Limited public information; surfaced at Startup Grind 2026.
trigger: Technical validation of the architecture claim — is the zero-hallucination positioning real differentiation or marketing? First named enterprise customer in a regulated vertical. Seed raise announcement. Founder profiles and academic/commercial background confirmed.

name: Fortiro
meta: Australia · Finnies 2025 Winner (Most Innovative AI in Finance)
desc: Document fraud detection and financial verification SaaS. Every financial document flowing into a bank, lender, or insurer gets checked through Fortiro — income verification, fraud detection, document redaction. Founded by three former PwC Australia directors (Sean Quagliani, David Weber, Amir Vahid) who lived the document fraud problem on the advisory side. Used by major AU financial institutions. A$3.5M seed raised Feb 2025. Won two consecutive AI fintech awards: 2024 Startup of the Year (Startup Daily Best in Tech) + 2025 Finnies Most Innovative AI in Finance.
trigger: Follow-on raise (Series A) announced — that's the entry window. Confirm ARR and growth trajectory. Check whether the cohort filter (founded 2022) is a dealbreaker or whether 2025 award + first institutional raise is the relevant signal. Also: are they expanding beyond AU financial institutions into other geographies?

name: Scrub AI
desc: AI-powered data cleansing platform for the insurance industry. Sits between insurers and their risk/exposure data flows — cleans SOVs (statements of values) and bordereaux before they feed into catastrophe models, pricing platforms, and binder management systems. Every piece of insurance risk data touching a London market insurer is a potential touchpoint. Founded ~2020, so outside the 2025/2026 cohort filter — but Innovate UK validation and InsTech London membership confirm they're actively growing. Founders: Alex Ley (regulatory lead), Nicola Turner (commercial/UI-UX), Andrew Pelton (CTO).
trigger: Check founding year more precisely (if 2020 = borderline on cohort filter). Confirm ARR and paying customers beyond London market pilots. If they have 5+ named insurer clients and recurring SaaS revenue, move to Watch List. The Innovate UK grant at £743K signals serious institutional validation.

name: Collaborative Conveyancing
meta: UK · Innovate UK grant £262K (Jul 2025) · Movera + LMS backed
desc: AI and NLP platform automating the pre-contract enquiry process in UK property conveyancing. 'Enquiry Manager' sits in the information flow between buyers' and sellers' solicitors — the stage that causes most delays in UK property transactions. Backed by Movera (LMS, ONP Solicitors, Cavendish Legal Group portfolio) and LMS (leading UK conveyancing panel manager). Founded 2022. Founder: Chris Harris. Classic B2B information pipe — every conveyancing enquiry between law firms routes through the platform once integrated.
trigger: Number of law firms actively using Enquiry Manager (not just trialling). ARR figures. Does the Movera investment come with distribution through their solicitor network (LMS manages panels for major lenders)? If LMS is routing all their panel solicitors through Enquiry Manager, that's a structural pipe.
